name: Barbell Wide-Grip Bench Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench, plant your feet and take an overhand grip wider than your shoulders.
Set your shoulder blades against the bench, brace and bring the bar above your shoulders.
Lower the bar smoothly to your mid-chest while keeping your forearms vertical beneath your hands.
Press the bar up and slightly back over your shoulders until your arms extend fully.
tips: Choose a grip width that keeps your wrists stacked directly over your elbows at the bottom.
Keep your elbows slightly below shoulder level rather than flaring them toward your ears.
